schema_basis: User demo: exact 12 question fields and linked possible_mistakes records
scope_note: Only the nine requested math/reasoning topics, classified by core solving skill. Not a transcription of all exam subjects.

language.questions: Original source wording, predominantly Bangla; original English terms and mathematical notation retained
language.options_and_key: Source content, with image references for graphical options
language.metadata: English; glossary maps Bangla to English

difficulty_scale: Easy / Medium / Hard; estimated, not empirically calibrated
review_policy: Review entries are isolated from topic files. Original keys are retained; a missing key is null. Solution/mistake arrays are empty and difficulty/time are null. Do not use review keys as verified labels.
identifier_policy: Q### preserves source numbering within a PDF. Use source_uid BCSxx:Q### when joining across PDFs.
transcription_policy: Whitespace, line wrapping and option-label punctuation are normalized. Readable Unicode or explicit linear mathematical notation represents positioned glyphs. Exact visible typography is preserved in audit crops. Substantive malformed questions and questionable keys are not silently repaired.
